'''Darth Nacheria''' was a powerful [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Prior to the [[Galactic War]], Nacheria planned to meditate in seclusion for a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] in order to [[Force vision/Legends|divine]] the Empire's future, but was convinced by the Empire to leave her [[Army/Legends|armies]] behind for use in the coming war.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Quiet, Please}}</ref>
